ambiguities_or_notes: The Matthew and First John passages are translated from Tolstoy's Russian compilation rather than replaced by a standard English Bible text.
The repeated один во всех / тот же бог structure is preserved as 'the one who is one in all' and 'the same God who is in you' rather than abstracted.
The closing distinction is kept explicit: love is a consequence, not the cause; consciousness of the divine spiritual principle is the cause.
